headline: Fandom War Between Two Online Communities Has Now Lasted Longer Than WW1
subheadline: Neither side remembers original cause; conflict continues on principle
summary: A conflict between two online fan communities has outlasted World War I, with no resolution in sight.
content:
The ongoing conflict between the VelvetEdge and StardustLegacy fan communities has officially lasted longer than World War I, marking 4 years, 3 months, and 17 days of continuous hostility with no end in sight.

The communities, dedicated to rival interpretations of the animated series "Celestial Chronicles," have been engaged in what participants call "The Discourse" since 2021. The original cause of the conflict has been lost to time.

"I think it started over shipping," said VelvetEdge moderator @ShipCaptain. "Or maybe character interpretation. Honestly, no one remembers. But we can't stop now. Too much has been said. Too many feelings have been hurt. We have to see this through."

StardustLegacy's position is equally entrenched. "They started it," said moderator @LegacyDefender. "We think. Someone definitely started it. And until they apologize, the war continues."

The conflict has produced 847,000 posts across platforms, 15 documentary-length video essays, and two academic papers analyzing the sociological patterns. Neither side has gained decisive advantage.

Tactics have evolved over time. Early stages involved direct argumentation. Middle stages saw doxxing attempts and platform manipulation (both condemned by current leadership). Recent stages have settled into "sustained mutual contempt" with occasional flare-ups during new season releases.

"It's not like we fight constantly," explained @ShipCaptain. "Sometimes we go weeks without major engagement. But then someone from their side posts something, and we have to respond. It's almost... comfortable now. Like a routine."

Both sides have lost track of the original argument's substance. When pressed on what they're actually fighting about, representatives provided contradictory explanations.

Mediation attempts have failed. A third fan community, "CelestialPeace," tried to broker reconciliation in 2023. Both sides united briefly to attack CelestialPeace, then resumed fighting each other.

"At this point, it's heritage," concluded @LegacyDefender. "New members inherit the conflict. They don't need to understand it. They just need to fight."
author: Alex Rivera, Digital Culture
